Canon logo is visible on the camera body/lens in photo 0.
No visible model nameplate (e.g. '80D') legible in the photo; angle and distance obscure small text.

A watermark 'GODSWILL' overlays the image, not seller-identifying info.
No photos of camera screen, battery compartment, memory card slot, shutter count, or accessories (charger, strap, bag).

Sensor spec cannot be confirmed from an external photo.
Internal component, not visible in any photo.

risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the top LCD panel or body nameplate showing model number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/generic Canon DSLR body, not as 80D

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have functional sensor/shutter.
risks.proof: Short video clip of camera powering on, showing live view and shutter firing.

risks.risk: Shutter count may be high, reducing value.
risks.proof: Photo of shutter count from a counter app or EXIF data screenshot.

risks.risk: Lens shown may not be the kit lens or may be third-party, affecting bundle value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of lens barrel showing brand and focal length markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body-only, lens value excluded

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body-only with no accessories

risks.risk: Physical damage (screen cracks, mount wear, fungus in lens) not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: Photos of LCD screen, lens front/rear elements against light, and lens mount.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume moderate wear

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model nameplate or top LCD panel showing 'EOS 80D' or actual model.
Video of camera powering on, autofocus engaging, and shutter firing.
Photo of LCD screen on and lens elements checked for fungus/scratches.
Photo of included accessories (battery, charger, strap, lens, bag, memory card).
Screenshot of shutter count if accessible.
response.reason: The photo confirms only a Canon-branded DSLR with a lens; the specific model that sets the price (claimed 80D) is not legible, and no proof of function or included accessories is shown.
